event: Nala winds down the spiral staircase into the round chamber, the amber light fading behind her.
She crosses to the trunk and lays her palms on the two pulsing knots of light.
The burn runs up her arms and through her veins, and the chamber drops away.
She sees the main hall long ago, every shelf full, lamps lit gold, in one quiet night.

memory.fact: Long ago the main hall had every shelf full and its lamps lit gold.
Long ago the main hall had every shelf full and its lamps lit gold.

event: Then books tear from the shelves by the hundred and scatter, and no hand she can see throws them.

memory.fact: Nala's fourth sync shows the hall's books thrown down in one night long ago, by no hand she sees.

event: The vision thins; she is back at the trunk, arms tingling, breath ragged, unhurt.
